domain: Brand Voice Enforcement - Orwell Rules Migration
summary: The prior audit's direction is right but its scope is materially wrong in two directions. It UNDERCOUNTED duplication by half: it found 6 rule copies and called that item "have"; there are at least 12 independently hand-maintained banned-word lists in executable code, including two live runtime paths it never opened (lib/marketing-brain/generate-briefs.ts applyBrandVoice, reachable via /api/marketing-brain/generate-briefs, and app/api/cron/gbp-health-check/route.ts, registered in vercel.json line 148/120 and scanning public GBP posts). The worst drift is in generate-briefs.ts, which still hard-fails on 'about', 'around', 'approximately' — the exact words the canonical vocabulary emptied to [] on 2026-06-02 — plus spacious/cozy/turnkey/leverage/navigate/comprehensive/foster. It also OVERSTATED the LLM gap: no LLM voice grader exists, but an Anthropic Messages harness with brand-voice instructions already exists (producer-output-class.ts line 172, lib/cma/judge.ts line 202), so the primitive is partial, not zero — though the producer-runtime path is gated behind PRODUCER_RUNTIME_ENABLED and loop-health-check reports it false. Two hard migration blockers were missed entirely: brand-voice-baseline.json total is 0, so the ratchet is fully enforcing with no grandfather room, and G35 (scripts/validate-producer.mjs line 52-56) hard-requires the literal string 'voice_guidelines.md' in all 24 producer SKILL.md files, so retiring that file fails ci:gates immediately. Every "missing" verdict on Orwell itself is confirmed: zero hits repo-wide.

items.requirement: Three new governing principles: never pander, never over-editorialize, be non-salesy without a banned-word list
items.evidence: scripts/brand-voice-vocabulary.cjs:34-160 (CLICHES, AI_FILLER, VAGUE_QUALIFIERS=[], MARKETING_SLOP, SMALLNESS_POSITIONING, FAKE_URGENCY, HYPE_OPENINGS, PANDERING) + BANNED_PATTERNS at lines 181-223. scripts/check-brand-voice.mjs:43 consumes VOCAB.BANNED_WORD_STRINGS; the only non-list mechanism is the 18 regexes at vocabulary.cjs:181-223. Line numbers verified by reading the file.
items.gap: [VERIFIED] Confirmed. Pandering is encoded only as five literal phrases (vocabulary.cjs PANDERING array) plus three Law-3 regexes; salesy-ness only as MARKETING_SLOP + FAKE_URGENCY strings. No principle-level representation exists. One thing the auditor missed that makes this HARDER, not easier: scripts/brand-voice-baseline.json is at total=0 (verified), so the ratchet has no grandfather headroom — a rule-set swap cannot be phased in behind an existing allowance, it either holds at zero or the gate has to be re-baselined deliberately.

items.evidence: grep -rniE 'orwell|passive.voice|politics and the english' across *.md *.mjs *.cjs *.ts *.tsx *.py *.json, node_modules excluded: exactly one hit, docs/research/TOOL_MASTERY_audio_2026.md:118, which is VO-delivery advice, not a voice rule. Re-run independently and confirmed.

scripts/check-brand-voice.mjs scanFile() lines 209-268: string-literal scan (extractStringLiterals, lines 84-134) plus JSX-text scan (extractJsxText), each matched against BANNED_WORDS regex and BANNED_PATTERNS. No POS tagging, no grammar parse. Confirmed no write-good/alex/retext/nlp dependency: none appear in package.json.
items.gap: [VERIFIED] Confirmed. Adding this touches more surfaces than the auditor implies: the same detector would need to exist in JS (check-brand-voice.mjs + eslint-rules/no-brand-voice-violations.js), Python (_producer_lib.py, used by 28 build_*.py — verified count is 28, not 29), and TS runtime (voice-precheck.ts, generate-briefs.ts).

BUT the reversal was never propagated: scripts/_producer_lib.py:391-397 still carries approximately/roughly/fairly/somewhat/about/around in SOFT_FLAGGED, and lib/marketing-brain/generate-briefs.ts:311 still carries 'approximately','roughly','about','around','fairly','somewhat' in HARD BANNED_WORDS with no soft tier.
items.gap: [CORRECTED: the auditor treated the 2026-06-02 reversal as a completed decision. So the repo does not merely have a history of abandoning cut-word bans; it is still actively running one in production code. The evidence against a regex-only Orwell rule 3 is stronger than stated.

Additionally, any Orwell cutover must reconcile four divergent cliché lists, not one.

items.evidence: No foreign-phrase or jargon list in scripts/brand-voice-vocabulary.cjs, scripts/_producer_lib.py, lib/email/voice-precheck.ts, lib/marketing-brain/generate-briefs.ts, or app/api/cron/gbp-health-check/route.ts. AI_FILLER (vocabulary.cjs:63-77) is a different category, as claimed.

items.evidence: scripts/check-brand-voice.mjs report mode emits {word, line, snippet} only (violation objects built at lines 233-266) with no replacement suggestion and no rewrite. scripts/_producer_lib.py grep_banned() (line 403) and grep_banned_categorized() (line 420) return sorted word lists only. lib/marketing-brain/generate-briefs.ts applyBrandVoice() (line 1262) returns {passed, violations:string[]} — rule citations, no rewrite. lib/email/voice-precheck.ts checkNewsletterVoice() returns {ok, violations:string[]}.
items.gap: [VERIFIED, with one nuance the auditor missed] Nothing produces a rewrite or verifies fact preservation. But the rewrite HARNESS is closer than 'nothing exists': lib/cma/judge.ts already calls client.messages.create (line 173) and already post-processes model output for brand-voice punctuation (line 202-203, converting em/en-dashes and semicolons in generated prose). That is a working precedent for LLM-generated-then-voice-corrected prose, and it is the natural host for a rewrite step.

items.gap: [CORRECTED: counts wrong (24 not 23, 28 not 29), and run/SKILL.md is not voice-blind.] More important, the auditor missed the single hardest migration blocker in this domain: scripts/validate-producer.mjs:52-56 defines MANDATORY_REFS_BASE containing the literal string 'voice_guidelines.md', enforced at line 464 across every producer by scripts/check-producer-skills.mjs (G35, wired as ci:producer-skills inside ci:gates — verified in package.json line 171). Retiring or renaming voice_guidelines.md fails ci:gates on all 24 producers immediately. Separately, check-producer-skills.mjs PRODUCER_ROOTS still lists 'video_production_skills', a tree that is now one directory — the gate walks a near-empty root and silently passes.

items.gap: [CORRECTED: coverage is broader than 'one of six surfaces' and the auditor cited a non-existent path.] Actual runtime-gated surfaces: newsletters (4 call sites), GBP posts (cron), brain-generated briefs (applyBrandVoice), plus 28 Python build scripts. Actual ungated surfaces: CMA prose, blog bodies, CRM 1:1 SMS/email, video VO, and any admin-authored copy outside newsletters. The structural point stands and is the real finding: every gated surface uses a DIFFERENT word list, so 'more coverage' has meant 'more drift', and an Orwell rollout inherits five divergent enforcement points rather than one blind spot.

shared_primitives_needed: A single canonical voice-rule source with GENERATED exports to every consumer. Twelve hand-maintained copies verified (see duplication item). Minimum viable shape: vocabulary.cjs stays canonical, and a build step emits the Python set for _producer_lib.py, the TS const for voice-precheck.ts and generate-briefs.ts, and the obfuscated list for gbp-health-check/route.ts, with a parity test extending scripts/__tests__/brand-voice-vocabulary.test.cjs to all consumers rather than the current two.

An LLM-graded prose review step callable from CI and from producers. Partially available already, not zero: lib/cma/judge.ts calls client.messages.create (line 173) and post-processes output for brand-voice punctuation (line 202); lib/marketing-brain/producer-output-class.ts builds an Anthropic system prompt that already instructs brand-voice compliance (line 172). What is missing is a grader that returns per-violation Orwell categories, plus a cost/latency budget for running it in CI. Note the producer-runtime path is behind PRODUCER_RUNTIME_ENABLED (app/api/cron/producer-runtime/route.ts:121) and app/api/cron/loop-health-check/route.ts:145 reports it false, so that harness may currently be dark in production.

A prose-surface registry enumerating every place client-facing text is generated and which gate covers it. Verified ungated today: CMA prose (scripts/build_cma_wrapper.py, lib/cma/render.ts), blog bodies (app/actions/blog.ts), CRM 1:1 SMS and email (components/admin/crm/SmsComposer.tsx, EmailComposer.tsx), video VO. Verified gated but each with a different list: newsletters, GBP posts, brain briefs, 28 Python build scripts.

A rewrite-verification primitive that diffs before/after prose and asserts numbers, names, and facts are unchanged. Nothing like it exists. Adjacent prior art to build on: lib/cma/judge.ts already sanitizes model prose without asserting fact preservation, and lib/marketing-brain/producer-output-class.ts already requires a citations array mapping each figure to a payload field — that citations contract is the closest existing shape for a fact-preservation assertion.

A gate-migration plan for the doc-name coupling. scripts/validate-producer.mjs:52-56 requires the literal 'voice_guidelines.md' in all 24 producer SKILL.md files, enforced by G35 inside ci:gates. Any Orwell doc rename needs this list updated in the same commit or ci:gates fails repo-wide.
open_questions_for_owner: Fully retire the banned-word mechanism or layer Orwell on top? Note before deciding: scripts/brand-voice-baseline.json is at total=0, so the current gate is a hard zero, not a soft burn-down. Removing the list removes enforcement in one commit rather than degrading it gradually.

Four of the six Orwell rules are not regex-tractable. Are you okay with those running as a non-deterministic, token-costing LLM review step per draft instead of a deterministic commit-time gate? A partial harness already exists (lib/cma/judge.ts, producer-output-class.ts) so this is wiring, not greenfield.

Before any Orwell work: do you want the twelve divergent banned-word copies collapsed to one generated source first? Right now lib/marketing-brain/generate-briefs.ts:311 hard-fails any brief containing the word 'about', which the canonical vocabulary un-banned on 2026-06-02. That is actively rejecting valid content today, independent of Orwell.

Retiring voice_guidelines.md breaks G35 (scripts/validate-producer.mjs:52-56) across all 24 producer SKILL.md files. Do you want the new Orwell doc to take that filename, or should the gate's MANDATORY_REFS_BASE be updated in the same commit?

Does Orwell apply to surfaces currently ungated on purpose — CMA prose, blog bodies, CRM 1:1 SMS and email — or do those keep the current exemption? VOICE.md's 'our language only' scope excludes reviews and broker-written MLS remarks; confirm that carries over.

CLAUDE.md's Video Build Hard Rules section still cites ANTI_SLOP_MANIFESTO.md, VIDEO_PRODUCTION_SKILL.md, and VIRAL_GUARDRAILS.md, all deleted in abd59955 (confirmed: only video_production_skills/captions survives). scripts/check-producer-skills.mjs still walks video_production_skills as a producer root.
